data.name: Farbad
data.gender_notes: Farbad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Farbad is derived from the Persian language and means 'Lord, Master'. It is a name that evokes a sense of strength, power, and authority. In Islamic tradition, this name is often given to boys to symbolize the belief that Allah is the true Master and Lord of all things. The name Farbad carries the meaning “Lord, Master” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farbad usually hope their child will grow to embody lord, master and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's supremacy and sovereignty.
data.etymology: Farbad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord, Master.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farbad total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_english.name: Farbad
in_english.long_meaning: Farbad is a masculine name of Arabic origin, meaning patience and perseverance. It is derived from the Arabic root 'brd', which conveys the sense of bearing and enduring. In the Quran, Allah is described as 'As-Sabur' (the Patient), reflecting the virtue of patience. The name Farbad embodies the qualities of steadfastness and determination, making it a significant name in Islamic tradition. It symbolizes the ability to remain steadfast in the face of challenges and is considered a strong and inspiring name for boys.
